name: AAV2 inverted terminal repeat, left (5' ITR)
notes: Left ITR as it appears on the reference genome plus strand. Contains the A, B, C and D regions (145 nt; the larger figure in Appendix B includes the D sequence). The reference record also annotates a flip oriented DNA feature at 42..83. The sense strand contains 0 ATG trinucleotide(s). Literature describing the element: doi:10.1128/JVI.45.2.555-564.1983 (the sequence itself comes from the GenBank record, not from the paper).
